text:
Priya: Notice: ap-southeast rack19 p95 spiking since 03:02 local, looks like egress queue pileup on a couple hosts. Anyone oncall?
Noah: I'm here. Pulling nic_tx_queue_len + pci counters. Quick grep shows host-19-03 and host-19-07 with sustained tx_queue_len > 200 for ~40s.
Lee: Were those hosts serving dedicated slices? If yes we shouldn't hard-throttle.
Noah: Yep, both are fractional-dedicated slices (ded-slice-210). Tenants: big-retail-sim and research-proxy. big-retail-sim has a bursty sampling job scheduled.
InfraBot: [alert] nic-queue-sustained@rack19 hosts=[host-19-03,host-19-07] duration=40s severity=medium. auto-action=none (dedicated-slice).
Priya: Proposed: soft quarantine the noisy tenant into an ephemeral warm-pool with tc-based egress shaping + keep KV warm. Non-disruptive if we handoff with `--preserve-kv`.
Lee: How about temporary fractional-rate-limit on the tenant process using cgroups + `tc`? Example: `tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 300mbit burst 32k latency 50ms`.
Noah: Doing handoff now: `allocator move-tenant --tenant=big-retail-sim --to=warm-pool-ap-southeast --preserve-kv`
Noah: Allocator: handoff accepted, warming cache on warm-pool-ap. Applying egress-shaper profile `shared-soft-250mbit`
Priya: After shaper p95 for host-19-03 fell from 420ms -> 95ms in 2m. Good signal. Monitor for billing impact.
FinanceBot: Notice: warm-pool usage will incur burst premium. Estimated delta so far: +0.25 GPU-hrs, cost delta ~$0.35.
Lee: Follow-ups: add a flag on dedicated slices to allow transient soft-throttle (opt-in per-tenant) + show egress-credit burn in console. Also consider auto-notify tenant owners before handoff if we can.
Noah: Root cause: tenant deployed a sampling job with beam=128 and no client-side rate limit. We'll ask them to patch.
Priya: Filed INFRA-1801 to track: "dedicated-slice soft-quarantine policy + billing integration". Assign to infra-scheduler team.
Lee: Also want a metric alert: if nic_tx_queue_len > 150 for >30s AND host in dedicated slice, create a ticket and add suggested mitigation steps.
InfraBot: Ticket created INFRA-1801 (policy + billing hook).
Priya: Keeping quarantine for 20m, will revert if stable. Thanks for quick triage :heart:
